inv.desc_es:
Se traspasa local de 420m2 en una de las zonas mas premium de Madrid, el barrio de Almagro se distingue por estar rodeados de embajadas,
hoteles y edificios de alto poder adquisitivo. Se trata de un local de 420 m2 ubicado en una palacete donde destaca sus tres grandes escaparates y
altura del local. Están distribuidos en 340m2 en planta baja donde se aprecia un bonito ladrillo vista y su suelo noble de madera. A la entrada del local encontramos una barra con mesas altas y continuando un gran salon donde también esta ubicada la cocina. En el interior, el local dispone de amplios espacios, techos elevados y una distribución versátil que se adapta tanto a un restaurante tradicional como a conceptos más innovadores. La planta sótano de unos 80m2 mas encontramos baños, cuarto taquilla y dos cámaras de frio. Licencia hasta las 02:00am, aforo para 66 con capacidad de ampliarlo, terraza para unas 4 mesas y 10 sillas
Traspaso: 230.000€ Renta; 11000€ + 1 mes de comisión de agencia.
No dejes pasar esta oportunidad de tener tu propio negocio en una de las zonas más exclusivas de Madrid. ¡Contacta ahora y descubre todo lo que este local tiene para ofrecer! .

inv.desc_en:
420m2 premises for lease transfer in one of the most premium areas of Madrid. The Almagro neighborhood is distinguished by being surrounded by embassies, hotels, and high-net-worth buildings. This is a 420m2 space located in a small palace, featuring three large display windows and high ceilings. It is distributed over 340m2 on the ground floor, where beautiful exposed brick and noble wooden floors can be appreciated. At the entrance, there is a bar with high tables, continuing into a large dining room where the kitchen is also located. Inside, the premises offer spacious areas, high ceilings, and a versatile layout that adapts to both a traditional restaurant and more innovative concepts. In the basement of about 80m2, we find bathrooms, a locker room, and two cold storage rooms. License until 2:00 AM, capacity for 66 people with the possibility of expansion, and a terrace for about 4 tables and 10 chairs.
Transfer fee: €230,000. Rent: €11,000 + 1 month agency commission.
Do not miss this opportunity to have your own business in one of the most exclusive areas of Madrid. Contact us now and discover everything this space has to offer!
THE PHOTOS DO NOT BELONG TO THE PREMISES
IMPORTANT: Please leave your phone number, name, email address, and availability for visits. Due to high demand in recent months, this is the fastest way to assign you an advisor specialized in your type of business.
If you need a foreign language translator, we also have this service available in English, French, and Chinese.
We are experts in commercial premises and can help you choose the best location for your business; we have professionals in Marketing, Architecture, Decoration, Management, Renovation, and Licensing.
ATTENTION: The information included regarding this property is not binding and does not form part of any offer or contract and may be subject to any modification requested by the owners. We also inform you that, in the event that verification of documents, licenses, floor plan surveys, or feasibility reports are needed, the expenses of the architect, technician, surveyor, manager, or lawyer will be at the expense and charge of the interested new tenant.
